name: Source-Effective ER Dark Matter Model Closure
definition: Internal closure of the recovered source-effective Dark Matter branch: hidden/load-bearing ER geometry has an explicit network representation, density/metric and stress-energy/Einstein interfaces, large-scale coarse-graining, and galactic readout equations. External physical identification is not promoted.
math: ER network W -> {g_ER, rho_ER/T_ER} -> Einstein/metric response -> {Phi_eff, v(r)}; exact source shell sector also has Delta mu !=0 => Delta phi !=0 => det g differs.
